features.name: Pub/Sub Push Worker Handler
features.description: Replace long-running ARQ process as the GCP worker entrypoint when JOB_QUEUE_PROVIDER=pubsub. Cloud Run worker exposes an authenticated HTTP endpoint (e.g. POST /internal/jobs/batch) that receives Pub/Sub push deliveries, validates the Pub/Sub OIDC token, decodes the message, and runs orchestrator.run_batch_workflow(workflow_run_id, payload). Return 2xx to ack; non-2xx for retry. Preserve trace context from message attributes. Worker can scale to zero (min-instances=0) because Pub/Sub invokes on each message.
